title: Grade 5 ELA — Editing for Clarity and Grammar
subject: English Language Arts
description: Practice with questions on verb tense, conjunctions, pronouns, sentence editing.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Which revision keeps the verbs in the same tense?
choices: We sketched the leaf and labeled its veins.
We sketch the leaf and will labeled its veins.
We sketch the leaf and labeled its veins.
We sketched the leaf and label its veins.

questions.question: Choose the pronoun: Rosa and __ will present the results.
choices: my
I
mine
me

questions.question: Choose the pronoun: Please hand the charts to Rosa and __.
choices: mine
me
my
I

questions.question: Which revision clarifies that Malik finished the model?
choices: After Malik finished the model, he called Lee.
Malik called Lee after he finished it.
He finished it after Lee's call.
After he finished it, Lee got a call.

questions.question: Which word shows a contrast? “It was late, __ we continued working.”
choices: and then
so
yet
because

questions.question: Which pair of conjunctions completes the idea? “__ the pen __ the pencil is in my bag; both are on my desk.”
choices: Not only … but also
Both … and
Either … or
Neither … nor

questions.question: Which has a comma after an introductory phrase?
choices: After, the game we returned the balls.
After the game we, returned the balls.
After the game we returned, the balls.
After the game, we returned the balls.

questions.question: Which joins two full ideas correctly with “but”?
choices: The room was cold but, the water stayed warm.
The room was cold, but the water stayed warm.
The room, was cold but the water stayed warm.
The room was cold, but, the water stayed warm.

questions.question: Choose the verb that agrees with the subject: “The box of colored pencils __ on the top shelf.”
choices: were
are
have
is

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct form of “to lie” in the present?
choices: The cat lie in the sun each morning.
The cat lying in the sun each morning.
The cat lies in the sun each morning.
The cat lays in the sun each morning.

questions.question: Which revision avoids a fragment?
choices: Turning back at the trail.
Because the trail flooded.
Because the trail flooded, we turned back.
The flooded trail after rain.

questions.question: Which revision fixes a run-on?
choices: I packed, the tent Bea brought the map.
I packed the tent. Bea brought the map.
I packed the tent, Bea brought the map.
I packed the tent Bea brought the map.

questions.question: Which sentence shows an action already finished before the bell rang?
choices: I had packed my bag before the bell rang.
I will pack my bag before the bell rang.
I am packing my bag when the bell rang.
I pack my bag every time.

questions.question: Choose the plural possessive for backpacks belonging to several players.
choices: the player backpacks'
the players backpacks
the player's backpacks
the players' backpacks

questions.question: Which verb completes the past tense sentence? “Yesterday, we __ the last bus at six.”
choices: catch
catching
catches
caught

questions.question: Which sentence uses a paired construction correctly?
choices: We can either walk or ride the bus.
We can neither walk or ride the bus.
We can either walk nor ride the bus.
We can both walk or ride the bus.

questions.question: Which sentence makes it clear that the coins were inside the display case?
choices: We saw three coins that were inside the display case.
While we were inside the display case, we saw coins.
In the display case, we looked out toward the coins.
We stood inside the display case to look at coins.

questions.question: Which revision means Priya made exactly one stop?
choices: Priya stopped only on the trail.
Priya stopped only once on the trail.
Priya stopped once on only the trail.
Only Priya stopped on the trail.

questions.question: Which word connects the ideas by showing time? “We waited __ the gates opened.”
choices: because of
beside
until
unless of

questions.question: Which choice uses parallel verb forms?
choices: We like hiking, paddle, and to skate.
We like to hike, paddling, and skate.
We like hiking, paddling, and skating.
We like hike, paddling, and skating.
